items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Johnny Sincere was playing the guitar.

ctx.x: In the real old days, they used guitar mostly.
Well, yeah, I understood because I heard his record by Louis Armstrong with his Hot 5 during them times. Johnny Sincere was playing the guitar. They didn't have no banjos then, I don't remember.
You didn't mention one of the very best, Marrero.
